title: Help Your Teen Start Tomorrow’s Work Without Taking It Over
summary: Use a Start-Runway Reset to identify one practical blocker, choose one small visible first move, stage materials, and let your teen try the opening minutes of tomorrow’s work.
seo_title: Help a Teen Start Homework Guide
seo_description: A parent guide to help a teen start homework without taking over: name one blocker, choose one small first move, stage materials, then step back from the work.
release_move: The parent helps set one practical starting line, holds access and wellbeing duties, and then steps back so the teen can try and judge a small work-session reset.

core_belief_shift.from: I need to push harder, supervise the whole task, or solve my teen’s difficulty starting work.
core_belief_shift.to: We can lower one practical barrier and let my teen test a small first move without taking over the work.

book_relevance.reason: War Playbook Chapter 19 gives a teen-facing way to redesign task conditions; this parent article provides a complete standalone setup tool without the book.

hero.alt: A teen chooses a first schoolwork step at a kitchen table while a parent stays nearby without taking over.

social_image.alt: A teen chooses a first schoolwork step at a kitchen table while a parent stays nearby without taking over.
